selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the speaker say the ruler wants people to do first?
questions.answer: He wants them to know who their ruler is and try to recognize him.

questions.question: What does the passage teach people to do when they see beautiful design and decoration?
questions.answer: They should recognize the ruler and admire his skill.

questions.question: What two responses are expected from people when they receive these blessings?
questions.answer: Obedience and thankfulness.

questions.question: What does the special mark placed on each work show?
questions.answer: It shows that each thing belongs to him and comes from him alone.

questions.question: Which three qualities are praised in the first group?
questions.answer: Self-knowledge, intelligence, and upright hearts.

questions.question: What question pushed the first group to seek more than surface enjoyment?
questions.answer: They wanted to know the hidden explanation behind what they were seeing.

questions.question: How did the first group react to the instructor’s message?
questions.answer: They listened carefully, accepted it, and benefited from it.

questions.question: What happened because the ruler was pleased with them?
questions.answer: He welcomed them into a higher palace and granted them ongoing happiness.

questions.question: What limited view did the second group have of the palace?
questions.answer: They cared only about eating and enjoying themselves.

questions.question: What happened after the second group became drunk?
questions.answer: They shouted, disturbed others, and broke the ruler’s rules.

questions.question: In the announcement, what is the main reason given for building and decorating the palace?
questions.answer: It is to help people know the ruler and understand his greatness.

questions.question: What should admiration of the ruler’s works lead to?
questions.answer: It should lead people to seek his love.

questions.question: What does the passage connect with the ruler’s mercy and kindness?
questions.answer: The same blessings and gifts show his compassion and gentleness.

questions.question: What idea about uniqueness is taught through those signs?
questions.answer: The ruler is completely one of a kind and without any partner.

questions.question: What happened right after the teacher’s message to the crowd?
questions.answer: The crowd divided into two groups.

questions.question: What did the first group refuse to believe about the palace?
questions.answer: They refused to believe it was pointless or just for play.

questions.question: What sequence of actions led the first group to success?
questions.answer: They listened, accepted the message, benefited from it, and acted on it.

questions.question: Why was that reward suitable for them?
questions.answer: Because they were obedient, well-mannered, and worthy guests.

questions.question: What did the second group choose over reflection and guidance?
questions.answer: They chose food, pleasure, and careless enjoyment.

questions.question: How did their private wrongdoing become a public problem?
questions.answer: Their drunken shouting disturbed the other guests.

questions.question: Who is being spoken to in the instructor’s announcement?
questions.answer: The people who came to see the palace.

questions.question: What is the right human response to seeing skill and beauty in the palace?
questions.answer: To appreciate it and try to please the ruler.

questions.question: What response is expected when people see the ruler’s mercy and compassion in the blessings?
questions.answer: They should thank him and show respect.

questions.question: What conclusion should the audience reach about the ruler after hearing this?
questions.answer: They should believe he is one, unmatched, and independent.

title: Parable Invitation by the Explaining Master and Conduct of the Two Groups
